channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Queen bees use surprising tactic to cope with pesticides
item.description: Honeybee queens exposed to pesticides can transfer some of the toxins into their eggs, a previously unknown survival mechanism that may have implications for colony health.

item.title: JWST reveals early galaxies may be four times more massive
item.description: Astronomers using the James Webb Space Telescope have found that massive early galaxies contain many more small, faint stars than previously thought, potentially making them far heavier.

item.title: Speaking multiple languages may keep brains younger by up to 13 years
item.description: Research suggests that multilingualism could slow brain aging, with speakers of four languages showing brains appearing around 13 years younger.

item.title: Archaeologists find 400-year-old Indigenous pot in Florida, puzzling experts
item.description: A perfectly intact Indigenous pot, buried for about 400 years, has been discovered, leaving archaeologists questioning why it was deliberately left behind.
